Definition: of uncertain affinity; a thunder storm:--shower.
BiblicalUsage: Ombros is a shower, a storm of rain. Jesus uses it once, in Luke 12:54, where the people see a cloud rise out of the west and say, There comes a shower, and so it is.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the people who read the clouds and miss the times are the warning of the parable, and the shower they can predict is the sign they cannot read.
